notes: Version 3.1 aligns the statements imported from Q14 with its current contract. The generation-triplet model built on the doublet soldered by [H-Spin] (the Sym^2(V) model of PRS) is stated to lie outside Q14's contract, which requires a distinct generation carrier; no substitute carrier is chosen, and the statements use only the abstract generation data of PRS's [H-Gen](ii). The spinorial Born-Infeld lift is stated under [H-Spin] and its supplied datum, the Lichnerowicz form under [H-Spin] with the continuum hypotheses inherited by the connection, the operator on the generation triplet as a model operator, and its three-level deficit structure as supplied rather than derived; a code docstring attributing a transport property to Q14 is corrected. The Q14 bibliography note is aligned with the programme's, and the bibliography carries the updated titles of O5, O6 2.0 and O19 1.3 committed since version 3.0.1. The statements of the note are unchanged; the restriction concerns the model instance.
